summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Next Day Disclosure Return on 29 May 2026 under Hong Kong Stock Exchange rules (via Form 6-K). The issuer repurchased 1,501,700 of its own listed ordinary shares on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong at HKD 19.961 per share. These repurchased shares were designated as treasury shares, reducing the non-treasury share count to 938,879,085. Total shares outstanding (including treasury) remained unchanged at 972,508,041. The transaction was authorized by the board and complies with listing rules. While a routine buyback disclosure rather than a transformative event, it represents a capital return to shareholders via open-market purchases. Watch for continuation of buyback program and potential impact on floating supply.
